response:
It sounds like you've been working incredibly hard to support your daughter, and it's understandable to feel worried when milestones aren't unfolding the way you'd hoped. You clearly know her well and are paying close attention, which matters a lot.

The pattern you're describing—the significant difficulty with potty training, the challenges around eye contact, and milestones that have persisted despite preschool—are things worth discussing with a professional who can actually evaluate her. I'd encourage you to talk with your pediatrician and ask specifically about a developmental evaluation. In many areas you can also request an assessment through early intervention or your local school district, often at no cost. The earlier a child gets tailored support, the more effective it tends to be.

In the meantime, try to ease the pressure around the toilet so it doesn't become a source of distress for either of you. You're doing the right thing by seeking answers, and getting the right people involved is the strongest next step you can take.
